en_how: A CC0 ceramic vase model from Poly Haven (glTF mesh with its normal and roughness maps) is parsed in the page and placed on a Three.js turntable. A generated blue-and-white lotus-scroll pattern is wrapped around the body with a cylindrical projection and mirrored tiling so the seam stays continuous, and a glowing glaze line in the shader sweeps from foot to rim, turning the white bisque into blue-and-white porcelain. The 3D layer renders with a transparent background over a generated beige studio backdrop, leaving only the floor shadow; a close-up adds three spec callouts and the camera pulls back for a fictional ceramics brand end card.
